title: Jazz at Lincoln Center PRESENTS: “World on a String: Swinging Songs of Broadway”
seo_title: Swinging Songs of Broadway Concert in Joplin, MO
description: This is a live jazz concert, "World on a String: Swinging Songs of Broadway," presented by Jazz at Lincoln Center and featuring vocalists Kate Kortum and David Marino. They reimagine songs from Broadway shows such as "Hamilton," "Wicked," "South Pacific," and "West Side Story" with jazz and swing arrangements. It takes place Sunday, February 28, 2027 at 2:00 PM at Connect2Culture, 212 West 7th Street in Joplin, Missouri; tickets are $50 plus fees.
